Definition: of Hebrew origin (H461); Eliezer, an Israelite:--Eliezer.
BiblicalUsage: Eliezer is an Israelite. In Luke 3:29, the text says "which was [the son] of Eliezer."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, eliézer means Eliezer, and I leave it at that.
